title: Hampton's changing band and the decline of big bands
summary: Big bands were suffering as small bands like Louis Jordan's thrived and the whole scene was changing.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: I think he was in the band at that time. You remember --
See, this the time that Lionel was changing a lot of people, you know. A lot of people were leaving him and he was having trouble keeping musicians with him, you know. Because --
Remember we talked about the bands were falling off during the war years. And this was the beginning when the small bands were really taking a hold of everything.

And the big bands were really suffering at that time, you know. The big bands were really wasn't doing, because, you know, the small bands like Louie Jordon -- those guys were really mopping it up, you know.
And the quartets and the Lindy Hoppers, and they had all these --
The whole scene was changing. Different things were coming in at that time, you know.
